summary: Full backend + frontend verification for the new Area master, master-options relations, default logo, and Supabase auto-connect features. Backend pytest (test_area_master_relations.py): 8/8 pass — GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/admin/master/area work with duplicate 409 and soft-delete, /api/admin/master-options returns {segment, purchasing_size, area, top} name lists (admin only; 403 for user), customer create+update with 'area' persists (verified via GET), and GET /api/admin/supabase returns configured:true & sync_enabled:true with a supabase.co URL. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): default brand-logo visible on Login; admin/admin123 login lands on Admin Dashboard; Master Data screen shows all 4 chip tabs (purchasing_size, segment, area, top), Area tab lists 10 seeded areas (Bandung, Batam, Denpasar, Jakarta, Makassar, Medan, Palembang, Semarang, …); Add Area via UI works (11 rows after add) and delete round-trip works; Add Customer form dropdowns Segment/Purchasing Size/Payment Terms/Area are all populated from master-options (Area shows Bandung, Batam, Denpasar, Jakarta, Makassar, Medan, Palembang, Semarang); App Settings screen renders LOGO APLIKASI (Ganti Logo) + WARNA/TEMA presets + DATA APLIKASI fields; About page shows default about-logo and version is tappable. No red screens, no console errors during authenticated flows. Only observed console warning is a benign RN Web deprecation: `"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".`

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web logs deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — non-blocking but should be migrated when convenient.

action_items: Optional: migrate `shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius` usages to `boxShadow` to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py master endpoints correctly return {id,name,description} without leaking _id (uses projection {_id:0}).
GET /api/admin/master-options is admin-guarded via require_admin — correct (matches the customer-form dropdown consumer which is admin-only).
Customer create/update accepts and persists 'area' as a string and dashboard by_area aggregation continues to include the new value (verified list & detail).
Supabase auto-connect: /api/admin/supabase returns configured:true+sync_enabled:true when SUPABASE_DEFAULT_URL/KEY are set in backend/.env — as designed.
admin-customer-form.tsx reads options via useQuery(['master-options']) and area is validated required — good relational binding to master data.
About page uses `about-logo` testID and version value uses `about-version-value` with tap handler — hidden admin-login route matches spec.
seed_data_creation: Test-scoped Area rows are created with `TEST_Area_<hex>` prefix and cleaned up (soft-deleted) in the same test. One UI-created area with prefix `UITEST_` was also removed after verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Storage token key is `cm_access_token`. Master types are {purchasing_size, segment, area, top}. Master-options endpoint is admin-only. Supabase env vars in backend/.env (SUPABASE_DEFAULT_URL/KEY) drive auto-connect; area-master rows will sit as pending queue items until the `areas` table exists in Supabase — expected & safe. Pre-existing pytest `test_create_customer_creates_queue_item` is timing-flaky and NOT a regression (per main agent).
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature verification, no bugs found.
